content: {"assumptions": ["Linearised around operating point ~30% volumetric moisture, pump at ~2.5 V average", "Capacitive sensor assumed linear 0-50% moisture = 0-100% readout, negligible sensor lag vs soil wetting", "12 cm pot holds ~0.8 L soil; water needed ~8 mL per 1% moisture rise", "Mini 3-5 V pump gives ~0-4 mL/s over 0-5 V, approximated as continuous PWM despite relay on/off in kit", "1 L tank assumed not empty during test, no mains refill, constant head", "Dominant wetting/percolation dynamics approximated as first-order tau ~120 s plus 8 s tubing/infiltration dead time; slow daily evapotranspiration lumped into self-regulation", "Buzzer and OLED are indicators only, not in control loop"], "controller": {"N": 1.0, "Q": [], "R": 1.0, "kd": 1.5, "ki": 0.0033, "kp": 0.39, "type": "pid"}, "controllerRationale": "FOPDT IMC PI + light D for FOPDT K=8 %/V, tau=120s, L=8s with closed-loop lambda ~30s.
